description: This Java class represents a ConceptMap object within the OpenMRS framework, used for mapping concepts to concept sources. It includes annotations for persistence, auditing, and search indexing, and provides constructors, getters, setters, and overrides relevant to handling concept mappings.

classes.name: ConceptMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping between a Concept and a ConceptSource, with fields for concept, reference term, and ID, including constructors and accessor methods.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this mapping.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this mapping.

methods.name: getConceptMapId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for this ConceptMap.

methods.name: setConceptMapId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for this ConceptMap.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTerm
methods.description: Returns the concept reference term, initializing it if null.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this object, alias of getConceptMapId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this object, alias of setConceptMapId.
